mode.title: Scan mode
mode.description: Which betterleaks command to run. 'global_github' is our addition - GitHub Code Search picks candidate repos then runs betterleaks on each.
enumTitles: github - org, user, repo, PR, issue, gist, action, release (you specify the target)
global_github - search all of GitHub by keyword/pattern (we add this layer)
s3 - AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 / MinIO bucket
dir - upload a tarball URL to scan filesystem

target_url.title: Target URL (github / git / s3 modes)
target_url.description: github: https://github.com/owner | https://github.com/owner/repo | https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123. git: any clone URL. s3: https://bucket.s3.amazonaws.com/prefix/ or https://account.r2.cloudflarestorage.com/...

global_search_query.title: Search query (global_github mode)
global_search_query.description: Required for global_github mode. Used as the GitHub Code Search query to discover candidate repos. Examples: 'CASHFREE_APP_ID', 'rzp_live_', '"sk-ant-api03-"'.

global_max_repos.title: Max unique repos to scan (global_github mode)
global_max_repos.description: Cap on how many unique repos to scan. Each repo runs betterleaks separately, so cost scales linearly. Default 25.

github_token.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
github_token.description: Required for github mode (recommended) and REQUIRED for global_github mode (Code Search is auth-only). Generate at github.com/settings/tokens. 'public_repo' scope is enough for public repos.

include.title: Include these resource types (github mode)
include.description: Pick which GitHub surfaces to scan. Default = repos.

exclude.title: Exclude these resource types (github mode)
exclude.description: Subtracts from the include list. Lets you scan everything except certain resource types.

exclude_repo.title: Exclude repos matching these glob patterns (github mode)

actions_workflow.title: Only scan these GitHub Actions workflow files (github mode)
actions_workflow.description: Workflow filenames like 'ci.yml'. Empty = scan all workflows.

since.title: Only scan API items created after this date (github mode)

until.title: Only scan API items created before this date (github mode)
until.description: github mode. Pair with 'since' for a date window.

git_workers.title: Parallel git workers per repo
git_workers.description: git / github modes. 0 = single process (lowest memory). Higher = faster, more memory.

log_opts.title: Git log options pass-through
log_opts.description: git / github modes. Passed verbatim to 'git log'. Examples: '--all --since=2024-01-01', '--author=alice', '-S secret_string'.

git_platform.title: Git platform (link format)
git_platform.description: git mode. Used to generate permalinks. 'github' or 'gitlab'.

validation.title: Enable live secret validation
validation.description: Probe each detected secret against its vendor API. Off by default. Only rules that ship with a 'validate' CEL clause will actually probe.

validation_status.title: Only include findings with these validation statuses
validation_status.description: Comma-separated list. Options: valid, invalid, revoked, unknown, error. Empty = include all.

validation_timeout.title: Validation HTTP request timeout (seconds)
validation_timeout.description: Per-request timeout for vendor API probes. Default 10s.

validation_debug.title: Include raw HTTP responses in validation output
validation_debug.description: Useful for debugging CEL validators. Verbose.

validation_extract_empty.title: Include empty extractor values in ValidationMeta
validation_extract_empty.description: Include validation extractor results even when they are empty strings.

validation_env_vars.title: Env vars accessible to validation CEL
validation_env_vars.description: Comma-separated env var names. Some rules' validators need extra credentials.

s3_access_key.title: S3 access key (s3 mode)
s3_access_key.description: Leave blank + check 'Anonymous' for public buckets.

s3_secret_key.title: S3 secret key (s3 mode)
s3_secret_key.description: s3 mode. Paired with access key for AWS / S3-compatible authentication.

s3_anonymous.title: Anonymous (s3 mode - public buckets only)
s3_anonymous.description: s3 mode. Skip credentials entirely - scans only public buckets/objects.

s3_region.title: S3 region (s3 mode)
s3_region.description: Required for non-AWS endpoints. 'auto' for R2, 'us-east-1' for AWS, etc.

s3_max_object_size.title: S3 max object size (bytes)
s3_max_object_size.description: Skip objects larger than this. 0 = default 250 MiB.

dir_source_url.title: Tarball / zip URL to download (dir mode)
dir_source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a .tar.gz or .zip archive. We download, extract, then run 'betterleaks dir' on it.

dir_follow_symlinks.title: Follow symlinks (dir mode)
dir_follow_symlinks.description: dir mode. Scan files that are symbolic links to other files.

stdin_content.title: Raw text content to scan (stdin mode)
stdin_content.description: Paste the full text you want scanned. Limited by Apify input size cap (~5MB).

redact.title: Redact secrets in output (0-100)
redact.description: Percentage of secret to MASK in output (0 = show all, 75 = show 25% / mask 75%, 100 = fully redacted). Useful when sharing findings externally.

match_context.title: Context around each match
match_context.description: Format: 'NL' for N lines (e.g. '5L') or 'NC' for N characters (e.g. '100C'). Empty = no context.

verbose.title: Verbose scan log
verbose.description: Enable detailed scan progress in the actor log.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: trace / debug / info / warn / error / fatal.

legacy_print.title: Use legacy key-value verbose format
legacy_print.description: Use the legacy gitleaks-style verbose output format (key/value pairs).

no_color.title: Disable color in output
no_color.description: Disable ANSI color codes in the verbose output. Default ON for cloud logs.

no_banner.title: Suppress betterleaks banner
no_banner.description: Suppress the betterleaks ASCII banner at start of run. Default ON for cleaner logs.

enable_rule.title: Only run these rule IDs
enable_rule.description: Whitelist. Empty = run all built-in rules.

custom_config_toml.title: Custom betterleaks config (TOML)
custom_config_toml.description: Paste a full TOML config to override built-in rules. See https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks/blob/main/.betterleaks.toml

ignore_gitleaks_allow.title: Ignore 'gitleaks:allow' comments in code
ignore_gitleaks_allow.description: When ON, allowlist comments in source code are ignored.

baseline_url.title: Baseline report URL
baseline_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a previous report JSON. Findings present in baseline will be filtered out (only NEW leaks are reported).

max_target_megabytes.title: Max file size to scan (MB)
max_target_megabytes.description: Skip files larger than this. Default 100.

max_archive_depth.title: Max nested archive scanning depth
max_archive_depth.description: 0 = do not extract archives. Higher values let scanner reach into zip-in-zip-in-jar.

max_decode_depth.title: Recursive decoding depth limit
max_decode_depth.description: Default 5. Controls how deep base64/url-decoding goes.

timeout_seconds.title: Command timeout (seconds, 0 = no limit)
timeout_seconds.description: Hard cap on the whole scan duration.

regex_engine.title: Regex engine
regex_engine.description: Default re2 (fast, no backtracking). stdlib supports more features.

experiments.title: Comma-separated experimental features
experiments.description: Upstream feature flags. Refer to betterleaks docs.

report_template.title: Report template content
report_template.description: Go text/template content for custom report format. Advanced.

diagnostics.title: Enable diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Comma-separated: cpu, mem, trace, http. Outputs perf profiles to the actor log.

exit_on_findings.title: Exit with code 1 when findings are present
exit_on_findings.description: Default ON. Turn OFF for monitoring (run never fails on leaks).
